preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 1000.
The integer k must be between 1 and 26.
All characters in the string s must be lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to make k different letters, the output must be 'impossible'.
If it is possible to make k different letters, the output must be a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of changes.
